app.name: Notes In My Way
app.tagline: Private notes that live on your disk. No cloud, no accounts, no telemetry.
app.credits: Global View made with React Flow (MIT).

blocks.refused: This block can’t be moved here.
blocks.help: Up and Down go from block to block. Alt+Up or Alt+Down moves the block, Alt+Right or Alt+Left indents or outdents a list item, and Alt+Shift moves a heading without its section. Enter picks the block up to choose where it goes.
blocks.movedFirst: Moved {block} to the top of the page.
blocks.picked: {block} picked up. Arrow keys choose where, Enter drops it, Escape cancels.
blocks.changed: That block changed, so it wasn’t moved. Try again.

slot.end: At the end of the page

slot.endOfTable: At the end of the table

blocks.hint: Drag blocks in the preview to reorder them; the Markdown on the left follows.

preview.cycle: Embedded note refers back to this page
preview.renderFailed: This page couldn’t be shown. The text is safe in the editor.
